featured_reviews.name: Sunny Killekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a Batali car washer from JA Patanwala, but to my shock, I received an old and used machine instead of a new one. The product clearly showed signs of prior use, and the package was missing key parts like the strainer.

Despite giving multiple reminders and requests for replacement or refund, the seller was extremely arrogant and uncooperative. This experience shows a serious lack of honesty and customer service.

I strongly advise buyers to be cautious before purchasing from JA Patanwala or Batali brand. Always check your package thoroughly upon delivery and avoid dealing with sellers who refuse to take responsibility for defective or used items.

#FakeProduct #UsedItemSoldAsNew #Batali #JAPatanwala #ConsumerAwareness
